name: Arphaxad
description: King who reigned over the Medes in Ecbatane, which he built with massive walls and gates; warred against Nabuchodonosor king of the Assyrians in the great plain of Ragau, was overthrown with all his power, and was taken in the mountains of Ragau and slain by Nabuchodonosor

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
